title: fisc client mark
description: A node the client makes and no document carries: the aggregate a cap folds a split's tail into, and the smaller-flows mark the reader's smallest-flow filter folds small printed ribbons onto. Go writes none and refuses a producer node wearing one; site/marks.test.mjs holds every mark the client builds to this shape. Every figure on one is a sum over cited ribbons, and it says so in its rationale and source note like any derived node.

id.description: The mark's prefix names its role; export.MarkPrefixes.

parent.description: The node an aggregate's split belongs to; empty for a smaller-flows mark, which spans whatever its ribbons reach and is drawn muted.

constraint_tier.description: A mark reads no fund type: the key is present so a mark is shaped like a node, and empty because no page classifies it.

derived.description: The invariant: the city printed no such line.

folds.description: The ids an aggregate stands for, which no parent chain records.

slot.description: The order key of the column the expansion's shaping draws the mark in, as on every node it draws: a split's tail sits in its members' slot.

locators.description: A smaller-flows mark's citations: every page its merged ribbons cite.

allOf.description: An aggregate names what it folded, and folds at least two: an aggregate of one is worse than none.
